findings.claim: The gate record publishes a derived number that contradicts its own timestamps: it says PR #35 merged '92 s' before the 07:47:22Z observation, but 07:47:22Z − 07:45:55Z = 87 s.
findings.evidence: tasks/reviews/s2-postmerge-gate.json — observations[0].what_commit 'PR #35 had merged 92 s earlier (07:45:55Z)' and commit_chain_since_pr31_merge.reading 'NOT the one merged 92 s earlier'; the same file lists 1ed784c committed 2026-08-23T07:45:55Z and the observation at 2026-08-23T07:47:22Z (git confirms 1ed784c at 07:45:55Z).
findings.acceptance: Both occurrences read 87 s (or the interval is dropped and only the two timestamps are stated); no other arithmetic in the record disagrees with its listed timestamps.

findings.claim: The S2 row was deleted from TODO.md in its UNRUN / 'awaiting human merge' form in the same commit that archives it, so the only full-row copy ADR-022 rule 1 points a reader to (the pre-split commit) still says the gate is UNRUN and the PR is unmerged — the Validation/Status cells were never updated to RAN — SATISFIED + record path before the move, which acceptance criterion 3 asks to see in the diff.
findings.evidence: git diff origin/main...HEAD -- tasks/TODO.md shows only a '-| S2 …' deletion; `git show HEAD^:tasks/TODO.md | grep '^| S2 '` Status cell reads '**pr — PR #31 APPROVED at round 3, awaiting human merge** … **Post-merge gate above is UNRUN**' and the Validation cell reads '— **UNRUN**, and unrunnable from here'. ADR-022 rule 1: 'the full row … stays in git history at the pre-split commit'; rule 2: disposition 'written into the row … before archival'.
findings.repro: git show HEAD^:tasks/TODO.md | grep '^| S2 ' | grep -o 'UNRUN\|awaiting human merge'
findings.acceptance: A commit on the branch in which the S2 row is still in TODO.md with Validation reading 'RAN — SATISFIED (tasks/reviews/s2-postmerge-gate.json)' and Status 'done — merged e6810a4; gate ran 2026-08-23 …', followed by the commit that moves it to DONE.md; `git log -p -S'UNRUN' -- tasks/TODO.md` then shows the S2 row's UNRUN replaced before it leaves.
